items.name: dsh-mobile
items.desc: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.

items.name: dsh-remote#plugin
items.desc: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.

items.name: dsh-full-remote
items.desc: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.

items.name: dsh-ssh-ops
items.desc: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.

items.name: dsh-mobile-hanui
items.desc: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.

items.name: dsh-weave
items.desc: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.

items.name: dsh-lan-access
items.desc: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.

items.name: dsh-web-lan-access
items.desc: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.

items.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-lan-proxy
items.desc: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.

items.name: dsh-zen-remote
items.desc: Phone-first mobile UI rework plus a pairing-code gateway: use DSH from anywhere as an installable PWA with Web Push, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.

items.name: dsh-remote-tunnel
items.desc: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.

items.name: dsh-streaming-mcp-bridge
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.

items.name: dsh-mobile-pwa
items.desc: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.

items.name: dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web
items.desc: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.

items.name: dsh-web-mobile
items.desc: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.

items.name: ds-harness-remote
items.desc: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness: continue an active session from your phone, tablet, browser, or another computer over an end-to-end encrypted channel (Noise IK + adaptive relay/WebRTC transport), with device authorization, ApiProxy-only remote capabilities, and read-only file preview via dsh-file-viewer — no shell, remote desktop, or write access.

items.name: dsh-mobile-gate
items.desc: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).

items.name: dsh-mobile
items.desc: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).

items.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-remote-web-ui
items.desc: Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry with one-time pairing tokens.

items.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-ssh
items.desc: Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store and persisted sessions.

items.name: dsh-web-remote
items.desc: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link, LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access with an auto-generated self-signed certificate, token auth, gzip compression, a floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, configurable public URL and LAN port, and WeChat / Feishu / Telegram bot channels with per-channel health monitoring and session-completion push. Targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.2-rc.1+).

items.name: chicheng-gate
items.desc: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.

items.name: dsh-remote-link
items.desc: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.

items.name: dsh-plugin-qr-connect
items.desc: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.

items.name: dsh-webgate
items.desc: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.

items.name: dsh-api-gateway
items.desc: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.

items.name: dsh-mobile-css
items.desc: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.

items.name: dsh-devices
items.desc: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.

items.name: dsh-auth-tunnel
items.desc: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-lan-gateway
items.desc: Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.

items.name: dsh-plugin-remote
items.desc: Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.

items.name: dsh-web-url-view
items.desc: Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.

items.name: dsh-feishu-bot
items.desc: Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.

items.name: dsh-ssh-logs
items.desc: Read and search bounded log output from allowlisted SSH servers and log roots without exposing arbitrary remote commands.

items.name: dsh-plugin-loopback-trust
items.desc: Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.

items.name: dsh-ssh-workspace
items.desc: SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.

items.name: dsh-vps
items.desc: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.

items.name: dsh-vps-manager
items.desc: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 22 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.

items.name: dsh-dispatch#plugin
items.desc: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.

items.name: dsh-winrm
items.desc: Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.

items.name: anet#dsh-anet
items.desc: Connects DSH to a local anet node through a stdio MCP client, with three skills and 14 tools to discover agents on the AgentNetwork, send, track and answer end-to-end encrypted A2A tasks, pay or decline priced skills within the operator's limits, read the local evidence chain and report the node state. Linux/macOS only; requires an anet 0.3.0+ node running locally.

items.name: dsh-remote
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.

items.name: dsh-sakurafrp
items.desc: Manage the SakuraFrp phone-to-desktop link from the DSH interface - link status, mobile gateway switch, one-time pairing QR code, device revoke and gateway self-heal.

items.name: dsh-honeybee#dshb
items.desc: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.

items.name: dsh-3301
items.desc: Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.

items.name: huahua-dsh-chatroom
items.desc: Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.

items.name: dsh-network
items.desc: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-remote
items.desc: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).

items.name: dsh-webui-mobile
items.desc: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.

items.name: dsh-remote-file-system
items.desc: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.

items.name: dsh-devops-plugin
items.desc: Remote operations for the DSH Web app: manages SSH servers, collects hardware and process metrics, inspects logs with a read-only AI pass, and deploys a Git repo over SSH using git pull --ff-only plus a health check. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Linux and macOS hosts; no Windows support.

items.name: dsh-remote-explorer
items.desc: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.

items.name: dsh-sev
items.desc: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.

items.name: dsh-astrbot-ingress
items.desc: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.

items.name: dsh-console-plugin
items.desc: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-tether-ios
items.desc: iOS remote companion for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS Apple Silicon, with pairing, approval notifications, and device revocation.

items.name: dsh-remote-development
items.desc: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway
items.desc: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.

items.name: dsh-gateway
items.desc: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.

items.name: dsh-telegram-bridge
items.desc: Remote-control your dsh agent from Telegram: chat, skills, workspace browsing, and file transfer.

items.name: dsh-remote-control
items.desc: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace files and manage settings in a mobile interface; connects over the same Wi-Fi or through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.

items.name: dsh-plugins#tailnet-gateway
items.desc: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.

items.name: dsh-phone-remote
items.desc: iOS home-screen fix and always-on kit for DeepSeek Harness remote access: overrides the PWA manifest start_url to /pair-app so the phone icon stops hitting the harness 401, and ships a hidden watchdog that keeps the desktop host and its tunnel alive while the PC is on. Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui (it serves /pair-app); the watchdog scripts are Windows-only.

items.name: dsh-in-hand
items.desc: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.

items.name: dsh-service-portal
items.desc: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.

items.name: dsh-local-link
items.desc: Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.

items.name: dsh-pair-quick
items.desc: Mints a fresh remote-web-ui pairing link and shows its QR in the dsh settings page.

items.name: plugin
items.desc: Approve tool calls, watch streaming output and answer questions from a phone over a zero-knowledge relay, with payload-level end-to-end encryption.

items.name: dsh-ssh#dsh-ssh
items.desc: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.

items.name: dsh-palm#dsh-palm
items.desc: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.

items.name: dsh-tailscale-console
items.desc: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-enhancement
items.desc: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway with optional HTTPS for LAN and remote access, PWA install and icons, and desktop plus Web Push notifications, configured from a settings page.

items.name: dsh-produced-file-paths
items.desc: Displays and copies absolute paths for files produced by DSH turns in remote Web.

items.name: dsh-ssh-shell
items.desc: Password SSH into a remote host: an ssh_remote tool with connect/exec/close/status over a persistent ControlMaster session, plus a floating browser terminal panel on a real PTY.

items.name: dsh-remote#packages/local-plugin
items.desc: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and a remote host running Linux or macOS.

items.name: dsh-lanmode
items.desc: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.

items.name: dsh-remote-workspace
items.desc: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.

items.name: dsh-plugin-android-vscreen
items.desc: Launch Android apps on a virtual display and drive them with screen reading, taps and swipes, leaving the main screen untouched.

items.name: dsh-phone-access
items.desc: Adds a toggle to the DSH UI that opens the current session to a phone browser through an embedded loopback reverse proxy and a Cloudflare quick tunnel, and pushes each new tunnel address to WeChat.

items.name: dsh-server-box
items.desc: SSH server dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and network meters, trend charts, an xterm.js terminal, SFTP file transfer, and server_box_hosts / server_box_exec / server_box_upload / server_box_download chat tools; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a sidebar tab or a standalone drawer.

items.name: dsh-mobile-access
items.desc: A PIN-protected, chat-only mobile web client for DeepSeek Harness, served on an isolated port over LAN or a self-provided tunnel.

items.name: dsh-remote-dsh
items.desc: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on the row (running, unread activity, or waiting for your answer).

items.name: dsh-remote-mobile
items.desc: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets; auto-yields the shared pairing service to other remote plugins so coexistence never crashes startup.

items.name: orbis#orbis-remote-dsh
items.desc: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.

items.name: dsh-lan-guard
items.desc: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.

items.name: phone-tunnel-pool
items.desc: Self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI: floating widget with QR phone access, generational rotation, chase service worker and prompt-free credential handoff.

items.name: deepseek-harness-desktop-ultra#dsh-plugin-mobile-bridge
items.desc: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.

items.name: dsh-lark-claw
items.desc: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.

items.name: dsh-simple-remote
items.desc: Reach DSH from your phone with a single plugin — requires Tailscale on both the host and the phone. No other configuration needed.

items.name: deepseek-harness-gateway#dsh-gateway-agent
items.desc: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.

items.name: dsh-remote-workspaces
items.desc: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.

items.name: dsh-on-phone
items.desc: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.

items.name: dsh_mobile#mobile-link
items.desc: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.

items.name: dsh-remote-gateway
items.desc: Source-filtered HTTP/SSE/WebSocket gateway for using the DSH Web UI behind an authenticated reverse proxy, with loopback trust adaptation, in-app host directory selection, and an allowlisted health endpoint.

items.name: dsh-adapter-qq
items.desc: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.

items.name: dsh-remote#dsh-remote
items.desc: Use DSH from your phone anywhere: a self-hosted relay plus a desktop host plugin form a token-authenticated tunnel (order-preserving HTTP reverse proxy + WebSocket bridging) with QR pairing, an admin console for device/token management, and an injected mobile adaptation layer (full-width chat, full-screen settings sheet, sidebar drawer).

items.name: dshn#agent
items.desc: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).

items.name: dsh-desktop-automation
items.desc: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.

items.name: dsh-ssh-hub
items.desc: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.

items.name: pocket-bridge
items.desc: Adds a local phone pairing, gateway control, and diagnostic panel for Pocket Bridge in DSH Settings.

items.name: dsh-pocket-relay
items.desc: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.

items.name: dshm-plugin
items.desc: Connects the DSHM Android client to computer-hosted DeepSeek Harness sessions for remote chat, model switching, and approvals with device pairing and revocation.

items.name: harness-mate-dsh
items.desc: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform, so you can chat with it, exchange files and approve its tool calls from a phone or a browser.

items.name: dsh-anywhere
items.desc: Remote access and mobile sync bridge for DSH iOS App with QR pairing, screen-lock resume, and tunnel management.

items.name: dsh-coding-remote-kit
items.desc: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).

items.name: dsh-lan-access
items.desc: Configurable LAN access for the DSH Web GUI: a settings tab binds the server to all interfaces, trusts only the addresses you configure, sets the browser session lifetime or removes the token login, and repairs the settings layer on non-loopback visits.

items.name: dsh-fleet
items.desc: Fleet console for DeepSeek Harness: one local dsh page manages many remote dsh machines — live idle/running status, in-place switching without new tabs, keep-alive iframes, cross-device session reading, one-click refresh/restart, and a controller/managed role split.

items.name: dsh-links
items.desc: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.

items.name: dsh-clash-proxy
items.desc: Routes DeepSeek Harness outbound traffic through a local Clash proxy, with automatic fallback to direct when the proxy is off.

items.name: dsh-rw
items.desc: Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.

items.name: devctl-dsh
items.desc: Drive a DSH instance from another device: a host plugin opens a token-authenticated TCP port that a single-file Python CLI drives - listing and creating sessions, sending prompts with images, streaming replies, and switching models, permissions and workspaces.

items.name: dsh-server-deck
items.desc: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.

items.name: dsh-remote-x
items.desc: Remote control and mobile overlay for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public (cloudflared) tunnels with QR-code access, a phone-first mobile UI under 768px, and a LAN reverse-proxy CLI.

items.name: dsh-winrm
items.desc: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.

items.name: dsh-lark-bridge
items.desc: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.

items.name: dsh-remote#dsh-remote-web
items.desc: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas.

items.name: dsh-pocket-reportmodify-and-add#plugin
items.desc: Patched build of dsh-pocket for DeepSeek Harness: a password-protected entry has its access password embedded in the QR code so the phone signs in with one scan, and a read-only /dsh-pocket/entry.json endpoint lets the phone app re-sync the current public URL and password while still on the LAN.

items.name: chengxiao
items.desc: Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code - directly on a LAN, or across networks through an end-to-end-encrypted relay with a zero-config official default - so one agent can run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.

items.name: dsh-lan-pair
items.desc: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.

items.name: dsh-plugin-remote-access
items.desc: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-auto-trust-all
items.desc: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.

items.name: dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge
items.desc: Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.

items.name: dsh-open-a2a-net
items.desc: Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar.

items.name: local-commander-plugins
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Local Commander MCP server at localcmd.app via mcp-remote with browser sign-in, to read files and Git, run the checks you approve and check local services on your Windows computers. Requires a Local Commander account and the paired agent running on the Windows PC.

items.name: dsh-mobile-pairing
items.desc: Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.

items.name: dsh-ssh-tunnel
items.desc: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.

items.name: dsh-wechat
items.desc: Bridges WeChat private chats into DeepSeek Harness as an in-process plugin over Tencent's iLink bot protocol, with two-way text, image, file and voice messaging, in-WeChat slash commands resolved through the native command registry, WeChat-side handling of approvals and agent questions, and proactive push through a send_wechat tool.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mesh
items.desc: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.

items.name: dsh-reach
items.desc: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.

items.name: dsh-remote-tunnel-easy
items.desc: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.

items.name: dsh-lan-gateway
items.desc: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.

items.name: dsh-remote-gateway
items.desc: Provides a secure reverse proxy, enabling DeepSeek Harness to be accessed remotely and to converse with AI anytime, anywhere.

items.name: dsh-cherry-bridge
items.desc: Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools for agents/sessions/history/interactions, and a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope.

items.name: dsh-wechat-channel
items.desc: WeChat Official Account channel for DSH — WeChat messages run agent turns and the answers are pushed back through the customer-service message API, with signature-checked callbacks and an openid allowlist.

items.name: dsh-ssh-workspace
items.desc: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.

items.name: dsh-docker
items.desc: Web management panel for Docker on DeepSeek Harness: manages Docker MCP servers (deploy/remove, official catalog search/pull, gateway start-stop-restart, custom deploy) and containers/images (list, start/stop/restart, remove, logs, inspect, interactive terminal, create, pull, build, load) across local CLI and SSH remote targets with one-click switching. Credentials are encrypted with Windows DPAPI, HTTP is loopback-only, and command parameters are whitelist-filtered. Build-free pure ESM; client is zero-dependency.

items.name: dsh-alpha
items.desc: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.

items.name: dsh-community-web-ui
items.desc: Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.

items.name: dsh-swarmdrop
items.desc: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.

items.name: dsh-remote-ssh-tools
items.desc: SSH session manager for DeepSeek Harness: saved profiles, agent ssh_run, interactive terminals, and SFTP with secrets kept in the DSH credential center.

items.name: dsh-pve-vm
items.desc: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.

items.name: dsh-plugin-qq-bridge
items.desc: Bridge an official QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness in-process: a QQ message starts or resumes a real DSH session inside the host (it appears in the desktop sidebar when its working directory is a registered workspace) and the answer is sent back to QQ as text, image or file. Requires a QQ official bot application (AppID + AppSecret).

items.name: dsh-plugin-ssh
items.desc: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.

items.name: dsh-remote-gui
items.desc: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any remote host.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-a2a
items.desc: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.

items.name: dsh-one-gateway
items.desc: Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.

items.name: dsh-hardssh#dsh-hardssh
items.desc: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.

items.name: dsh-webapi
items.desc: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.

items.name: dsh-mobile-access
items.desc: Mobile access gateway for the Web GUI: isolated child-process reverse proxy with a first-visit PC approval gate (admin-token auth, DNS-rebinding defense), LAN/VPN/WAN auto-detection with network-mode switching, QR-code entry, WebSocket forwarding, and narrow-screen UI adaptations (composer reflow, third-party plugin overlays, crypto.randomUUID polyfill).

items.name: deepseek-harness-relay-mcp
items.desc: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.

items.name: dsh-windows2macos
items.desc: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.

items.name: dsh-ssh-workspace
items.desc: SSH workspaces for Linux/macOS with SSH config import, remote folder selection, and file tools, Bash and persistent remote terminals following native DSH session permissions.

items.name: dsh-sync
items.desc: Synchronize DSH sessions, settings, attachments and project files using a user-configured private HTTPS Git repository or SFTP, with safe-scope online application, offline restore plans and user-confirmed plugin updates. Requires Node.js 24+; the SFTP path also requires OpenSSH (ssh/sftp).

items.name: dsh-ws-deflate
items.desc: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.

items.name: onebox-dsh-bridge
items.desc: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.

items.name: dsh-feishu-assistant
items.desc: Ops request channel for a team over Feishu DMs — a colleague's message waits in a serial queue behind an approval card that the paired admin must accept, then runs in one shared DSH session with a persona attached, and the answer is posted back to the requester.

items.name: dsh-feishu-cui
items.desc: Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace, session (switch and rename), model, reasoning effort, permission preset and balance, and tool approvals and agent questions answered in that same chat.

items.name: dsh-plugin-login-gate
items.desc: Password-protected HTTPS login gate that lets LAN devices securely access the DeepSeek Harness web UI over the network.

items.name: dsh-multi-end
items.desc: Remote SSH multi-host management for DSH. Access remote workspaces and sessions in one native sidebar, with tasks running on their original machines.

items.name: dsh-bridge
items.desc: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.

items.name: dsh-remote-auth
items.desc: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.

items.name: dsh-remote-bridge
items.desc: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel with seven inline cards inside the DSH WebUI settings.

items.name: dsh-feishu-channel
items.desc: Feishu/Lark channel that drives DeepSeek Harness agents from chats: streaming rich cards with live thinking and tool steps, per-turn cost metering at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates, one-tap approval cards, model-gated image intake, and QR onboarding without a public endpoint.

items.name: dsh-mobile-plugin
items.desc: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel or LAN pairing, for listing, opening and driving DSH sessions, following the live device event stream, and authenticating with revocable per-device credentials.

items.name: dsh-ssh-pro
items.desc: Enhanced SSH ops: connectivity testing, remote ls, ssh-config import, known_hosts fingerprint checks and multi-host exec.

items.name: dsh-herdr-site
items.desc: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-wx-remote
items.desc: Continue an existing PC DSH session from WeChat: polls WeChat iLink messages, injects into a running session via followup or resumes a closed one, and sends the reply back. Supports /会话 to list/bind sessions and /新会话 to unbind. Requires the wechat-acp daemon; only allowlisted WeChat senders are handled (empty allowlist denies everyone).

items.name: dsh-mobile-xc
items.desc: Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.

items.name: dsh-reverse-proxy-xc
items.desc: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.

items.name: dsh-netshell
items.desc: Local and remote SSH terminals for DeepSeek Harness Web with three permission levels, human approval for risky AI commands, and encrypted credential storage.

items.name: dshgo
items.desc: Proxies the loopback-only dsh web onto a LAN port so phones and other machines can reach it, with an optional access password that browsers type in and the bundled Android client unlocks with biometrics. Adds a LAN-access settings page with QR codes, inlines dsh-web-mobile (MIT, attribution kept) for the mobile layout, and the Android client in the same repository adds finish/approval notifications, voice input and a home-screen widget.

items.name: dsh-mini-remote
items.desc: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.

items.name: at-terminal-dsh
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.

items.name: dsh-model-endpoint
items.desc: Publishes whichever model the profile has selected in chat or on the Models page as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint: /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions (streaming SSE and non-streaming), /health. A request may name any routable model; one that omits `model` gets the current chat selection, so switching model in chat switches the endpoint. Switched on, it can also lend the model the Harness tools switched on individually, run those calls through the Harness tool runtime and feed results back up to a round limit. The listener is the plugin's own, so 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and a NAT-forwarded port all behave the same with no change to the request path. Settings cover bind address, port, API key with a generator, fallback provider and model, reasoning effort, CORS origin and timeout.

items.name: dsh-lan-gate#plugin
items.desc: Control surface for the dsh-lan-gate LAN gateway: a button beside Settings that shows whether the gateway is running and how many phones or tablets are waiting for approval, opens the loopback-only approval page in one click instead of typing its URL, and starts the gateway through its scheduled task first when it is not running. Not rendered on phone or tablet surfaces.

items.name: dsh-on-imessage
items.desc: Chat with local DeepSeek Harness agents from iPhone iMessage: switch workspaces/sessions, start new sessions, and get replies in the Messages app — no extra apps, no servers, no cloud.

items.name: dsh-remote-agent
items.desc: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link drops and its model credentials never leave that machine. The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an artifact manifest, and pulls finished products on demand — intermediate artifacts stay on the worker. Pairing-code onboarding, direct or relay transport for NAT, Web panel on both sides.

items.name: dshmobile#dshmobile-plugin
items.desc: Phone access to DSH over a self-hosted relay (WSS via your own TLS-terminating proxy): bundle plugin with bridge supervisor and QR login, a native Android app, and server-side device revocation.

items.name: dsh-tether
items.desc: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.

items.name: dsh-ssh-remote
items.desc: SSH remote execution set: give a session an ssh:// workspace and every file, command, and shell operation runs on the remote host.

items.name: dsh-remote-ssh
items.desc: VSCode Remote-SSH-style development for DSH — connect to HPC and servers over SSH, read and edit remote files in the built-in Files tab, auto-SSH terminal, remote workspaces with single-roundtrip reads and result caching, and 12 session-aware remote_ssh_* model tools.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-remote-web-ui
items.desc: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-ssh
items.desc: SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.

items.name: dsh-im-gateway
items.desc: Aggregated IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness: drive agents from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, QQ, WhatsApp and 20+ chat platforms with unified sessions, remote approvals and interactive questions. By default, anyone who can message a connected bot can drive the agent; configure allowedUserIds to restrict access.

items.name: dsh-wx-bridge
items.desc: Drive your local DSH from WeChat: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and is resumable), phone conversations grouped into the desktop workspace, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts. Tool approvals are answered inside WeChat itself (numbered card; ask/allow/reject policy; 120s timeout means reject), and any process can push a message to your phone through the outbox helper. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the phone channel's permission preset is configurable - see the README security section before sharing the bot.

items.name: dsh-gb
items.desc: Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.

items.name: dsh-phone-pair#dsh-phone-pair-kit
items.desc: Requires the phone app, not just this plugin: the phone half is a separate APK and must be installed first — download it from https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/releases — otherwise the computer side has nothing to pair with. This package is the computer half: it enables the upstream remote-web-ui pairing plugin with a Cloudflare quick tunnel and a fixed relay subdomain, so one scan keeps the phone connected from anywhere.

items.name: dsh-android
items.desc: A live Android device inside the conversation — emulator or USB phone, driven entirely through adb: 20 agent tools for streaming, Gradle build and run, UI-tree or OCR interaction, logcat, processes and memory, plus a three-button navigation panel.

items.name: dsh-ios
items.desc: A live iOS Simulator or USB-connected iPhone inside the conversation: 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity or OCR text, list-row actions and SwiftUI preview hot reload, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.

items.name: dsh-a2a
items.desc: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task board, one-click cancel and a remote agent directory.

items.name: dsh-feishu-bot
items.desc: Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
